title: Infinite/unbounded game state
description: The schema assumes finite state. How do we handle games with unbounded state? Examples: deck-builders that add cards during play (Dominion), procedurally generated maps (Catan expansions), games where players create new pieces. Does the component registry need dynamic instantiation? Is this a WASM concern or does the declarative layer need to express it?
close_reason: Option A: all component types declared upfront, instantiated dynamically at runtime. count sets initial supply, Place action creates new instances. Deck-builders declare full card pool. Truly procedural content is a Tier 2 WASM concern.
